name: Simple Live
tagline: Watch live stream in a simple way
blurb: Simple Live is a cross-platform application written with Flutter that allows you to watch live streams from various platforms, including Huya, Douyu, Bilibili, and Douyin.
description:
Simple Live is a cross-platform application written with Flutter that allows you to watch
live streams from various platforms, including Huya, Douyu, Bilibili, and Douyin. It's
available on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android TV.

Note: This app is currently only available in Simplified Chinese.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
